column5: ★ DOWNGRADED done -> partial 2026-08-05. It was recorded `done` with ZERO of its 13 frames ever visually verified, and pulling the frames finds four flat mismatches. (1) PER-DIFFICULTY BOARD PALETTE MISSING. Sampled off the frames bucket-by-bucket: Easy 9069-5304 runs #90E3E7 -> #0078E6 (cyan/blue), Medium 9095-5369 runs #A1E03C -> #1A9627 (green), Hard 9095-4812 runs #E590F2 -> #9744D5 (magenta). PlinkoGame.tsx:161 hardcodes ONE ramp - the Easy one - and paints it on all three difficulties, so Medium and Hard render the wrong colourway entirely. (2) THE RAMP IS MIRRORED, NOT SWEPT. Every frame is symmetric about the centre bucket: #90E3E7 at BOTH edges, the deep stop in the middle. getMultiplierSlotColors (line 179) maps t = index/(total-1) monotonically 0->1, so the right half of the board is colour-inverted against Figma. The comment at line 157 asserts the frame is 'NOT a symmetric center-out ramp' and is wrong - the 9 stops it lists are exactly the 9 distinct colours of the mirrored half, i.e. correct stops extracted from half the row and then stretched across all of it. (3) THE THREE BALL FRAMES ARE NOT BUILT. 9137-10213 / 10215 / 10217 are flat 10px discs, one per difficulty, at #56C7F3 (Easy), #3BFF00 (Medium), #DC4CE9 (Hard); PlinkoGame.tsx:745-756 draws a single hardcoded orange-red radial gradient (#ffdd44 -> #cc2200) with an orange glow and a white specular, identical on all three. (4) Auto panel 9104-6170 labels the field 'Number of Bets:' with an infinity affordance at its trailing edge and 0 = unlimited, and its CTA still reads 'Bet'; the code labels it 'Number of bets', clamps to 1..MAX_ACTIVE_BALLS=25 with no unlimited state, and relabels the CTA 'Start Autobet'. WHAT IS GENUINELY RIGHT: the detail page IS built and routed (/play/plinko -> PlinkoPage + PlinkoPageSections, same widget as the modal at variant=fullscreen), and the bucket VALUES match the frames element-for-element (Easy 16-row = 16x 9x 2x 1.4x 1.4x 1.2x 1.1x 1x 0.5x mirrored; Hard 16-row = 1K 130x 26x 9x 4x 2x 0.2x x5 mirrored), with all five canonical tables byte-identical across PlinkoGame.tsx:137, PlinkoTypes.ts:47, points-game:195, game-settlement:2488 and the Go chain plinkoBPS in gaming_settle_models.go:612. Bucket selection is server-authoritative on both live rails; the client Math.random path is cosmetic and discarded before payout. ★ CAVEAT 1: a SIXTH copy in gridGamesService.ts:753 has low/12 wrong in 11 of 13 buckets (31.2% edge vs the canonical 1.02%) and mints serverSeed in the browser - it is dead, and must never be wired up. ★ CAVEAT 2: PlinkoGame.test.ts declares CLIENT_MULTIPLIERS and SERVER_MULTIPLIERS as two hardcoded literals INSIDE the test and compares them to each other, importing neither real source - exactly how the gridGames divergence survived. No _shared/plinko.ts exists, unlike every other game.
